frozenDependencies: all shoulder bay bodies and macro domes
requiredFeatures: One large deeply recessed purple royal double door centered at the stair termination, with a pointed/arched top and a visible gold bee sigil.
A thick multi-layer gold arch surround whose outer width is at least 1.05 world units and whose dark recess produces readable depth at phone scale.
One large purple-backed honeycomb rose window above the door, with at least one outer frame and six radial cell/petal divisions.
Two dominant lower honeycomb window bays flanking the entrance and two subordinate upper bays; each needs a dark inset, thick gold frame and warm amber inner glow.
Vertical facade ribs and occupied-floor bands connecting the doorway, rose window and side bays so the entrance reads as an inhabited cathedral axis rather than a blank prism.
Two purple royal banners placed symmetrically beside—not over—the door; their lower edges must clear the stair and door opening.
All facade parts must sit on or embed into the accepted macro surfaces with no floating gaps or z-fighting.
phoneRead: Purple door is the first focal point.
Rose window is the second focal point.
At least four large honeycomb bays remain individually legible.
Gold-versus-dark inset contrast survives the overview camera.
strictRejects: door narrower than the stair arrival
rose window floating in front of the keep
facade details placed on rear or side by radial repetition
any change to accepted macro silhouette

capture.gate: All required categories at least 0.85 unless explicitly covered by the palace-macro-only user-accepted drift.
